description: Published-site integrity contract. Validates project-owned documentation URLs and Doxygen navigation targets against the ACTUAL generated HTML, not against source declarations -- a page can declare @page and still be excluded from the build, and a canonical-looking URL can still name a page that is never generated.

forbidden_url_patterns.reason: Only the /picurv-docs/ root redirects; individual page paths under it return 404. Use the canonical /docs/picurv/ base.
